rule.explanation: Load-responsive transformer fault protection relays must be set to prevent exposure to fault levels and durations exceeding the transformer's mechanical withstand capability.

reason: requires fault energy and mechanical withstand capability, neither observable in Grid2Op

rule.explanation: The transformer must be allowed to operate at the specified overload level for at least 15 minutes.

reason: compound: requires overload_duration, not observable in Grid2Op

rule.source: IEEE C57.109-1993 / Grid Code Provision, Transformer Overload Capacity
rule.explanation: Transformers must sustain an overload of at least 150% of nameplate rating (or 115% of emergency rating) for a minimum of 15 minutes to allow for operator intervention.

reason: compound: requires time_seconds, not observable in Grid2Op

rule.source: IEEE C57.109-1993 / Grid Code Provision, Transformer Temperature Supervision
rule.explanation: Relay supervision elements must be set to activate no less than 100°C for top oil temperature or 140°C for winding hot spot temperature.

reason: unobservable: top_oil_temp_c and winding_hot_spot_temp_c are not available in Grid2Op

rule.source: Grid Code Provision, Transmission Line Protection Setting
rule.explanation: Transmission line distance relays must be set to a maximum of 125% of the apparent impedance.

reason: unobservable: relay_impedance_setting_pu is a protection setting, not an operational state variable

rule.source: Grid Code Provision, Transmission Line Protection Setting
rule.explanation: The maximum torque angle (MTA) must be set to 90 degrees or the highest value supported by the manufacturer.

reason: unobservable: mta_deg and manufacturer_max_mta_deg are protection settings, not observable states

rule.source: Grid Code Provision, Transmission Line Protection Setting
rule.explanation: Relay loadability must be evaluated in amperes at the trip point using a voltage of 0.85 per unit and a power factor angle of 30 degrees.

reason: unobservable: relay loadability evaluation parameters are configuration settings, not grid state variables

rule.source: Grid Code Provision, Transmission Line Protection Setting
rule.explanation: The relay setting component must include at least 87% of the current calculated during loadability evaluation.

reason: unobservable: relay_setting_component_pct is a protection setting, not an observable grid state

rule.explanation: Transformers must be designed to withstand a winding hot spot temperature not exceeding 180 degrees C.

reason: temperature: winding_hot_spot_temp_C is not an observable variable in Grid2Op

rule.explanation: Bubble formation may occur in the transformer if the winding hot spot temperature exceeds 140 degrees C.

reason: temperature: winding_hot_spot_temp_C is not an observable variable in Grid2Op

rule.explanation: Relay settings must not expose the transformer to fault levels and durations exceeding the limits specified in the standard.

reason: unobservable: requires fault_level and fault_duration which are not Grid2Op observables

rule.condition: circuit_capability != calculated_circuit_capability or planning_coordinator_agreement == false or transmission_operator_agreement == false or reliability_coordinator_agreement == false
rule.explanation: Calculated circuit capability must be used as the Facility Rating and requires agreement from the Planning Coordinator, Transmission Operator, and Reliability Coordinator.

reason: unobservable: requires administrative agreement status and calculated circuit capability comparison

rule.explanation: Owners must maintain evidence such as spreadsheets or correspondence demonstrating the use of calculated circuit capability and required agreements.

reason: unobservable: requires evidence_of_facility_rating and evidence_of_agreement which are not Grid2Op observables

rule.explanation: The circuit must comply with the standard if the loading exceeds 115% of the Facility Rating when the rating is based on a loading duration of up to four hours.

reason: compound: requires loading_duration_hours, not observable in Grid2Op

rule.explanation: The circuit must comply with the standard if the loading exceeds 120% of the Facility Rating when the rating is based on a loading duration greater than four and up to eight hours.

reason: compound: requires loading_duration_hours, not observable in Grid2Op

rule.explanation: The circuit must comply with the standard if the loading exceeds 130% of the Facility Rating when the rating is based on a loading duration greater than eight hours.

reason: compound: requires loading_duration_hours, not observable in Grid2Op
